nom: Erborian Centella Cleansing Oil with Centella Asiatica

avis.titre: My all time favorite night oil cleanser
avis.texte: Ive been using this consistently at night. If i skip its bc i didn't go to the gym. But ovverall this has helped my blackheads tremendously!! They were not kiddng that oil pulls oil lol idk i thought that was a myth.. this has proved me wrong. my pores in my t zone/nose has shrunk. Love it

Not only is this oil great at cleansing, but believe it or not, this gives me the closest and smoothest shave as well! I used this when my shaving oil ran out and this product worked a million times better!
This cleansing oil is so lovely on my sensitive skin, great a removing makeup without drying out my skin.
This is a lovely product, it leaves skin feeling cleansed yet soothed and is gentle on the skin. It removes make-up quickly and effectively and would definitely recommend it for all skin types.
Great product, removed all trace of makeup without feeling greasy, a little goes a long way. Skin feels clean but not stripped like some cleansers do.
It's good at cleansing, but it left an oily residue on my skin when I washed it off. I think this would probably be best for a dry skin type. I have combination skin for reference.

I've tried so many cleansers and make up removers, including ones with good reviews, but this is the only one that I found really works to remove my mascara properly. The product is a bit scented so I am not sure how it will work on my sensitive skin long term, but really impressed initially.
I loved it since the first time I tried it — cleans and removes make up while leaving my skin nourished
It cleanse my skin brilliantly removing makeup and this new routine involves face massage, which I never did using different face soaps/cleansers. I love this product❤?

I have really sensitive skin , I've been using another brand of cleanser for years which I'm quite happy with. After trying your excellent BB cream I thought i would give this oil and cleanser duo a try. . . . . . . well I'm so impressed , my skin feels great, the smell and texture is lovely and it has now replaced my old product and will be purchased monthly from now on! Everything I buy from Eborian gets better and better! Please don't change anything :-)
Such a light gentle oil works brilliantly I use the gel aswell my skin normally goes tight and dry straight away but not with these the oil feels light and gentle
Not great, I would suggest to work on a micellar water formulation
I thought I was cleansing my skin....until I tried this. It really gets the grime and make up off and I love it. And, as with all their products, it is fine for my newly sensitive skin

This is a lovely cleansing oil. It takes some getting used to (for my skin too as for the first couple of weeks I did have a few extra blemishes) but after that, my skin is brighter, clearer, my pores are less visible and my skin feels in better condition. I use this with a warm face cloth and then double cleanse with the cleansing gel and together they have done wonders for me! And the scent is *chefs kiss*.
I have skin problem and it's hard to find right product. I can use it few times per day and I don't have any allergic reaction and my skin is glowing
I love this product. It leaves my skin so soft. Smells lovely too. I don't use anything else now. My skin had dry patches and now that has completed gone.
Very good for my dry, but sensitive skin at the same time! A must!

My poor fifty-something menopausal skin was quite a riot tbh! One of my Insta faves @wearsmymoney -Kate H-recommended this and what a transformation! In only a few weeks my skin feels smoother and plumper and just healthier. I have now switched to all Erborian products for my skincare routine. Cannot recommend this enough! Use with Centella Cleansing Gel for even better results!

Love the texture and feel of the cleanser it's very effective and removes all traces of make up, it's especially good at removing any remaining eyelash glue which can get stuck to lashes. I will not be purchasing any other cleaner since using this one.
Works well and smells great. Too much comes out with each pump though so you get through it a bit quickly
It smells great, feels lovely and soft and doesn't sting my eyes.

avis.titre: My new favourite make up melting cleanser
avis.texte: I added this to my basket to get free postage if I'm completely honest. I usually just buy the BB creams but this has been my new favourite. It's such a lovely consistency and melts all my makeup away without clogging my skin up. LOVE!

I have used Centella cleansing oil for a few weeks now. It doesn't leave my skin dry or oily after use but moisturised and nourished. The smell is lovely too. This is my favourite routine every evening now.
My go to for a double cleanse with the Erborian gel or foam. Removes make up easily, is very gentle and leave skin feeling super soft. A little goes a long way so don't need to restock often.

This is such a lovely feeling to apply at the end of the day. It definitely dissolves eye make up really well and mostly gets off all the make up off the skin - occasionally I have the slightest residue left. Smells and feels wonderful!

I have suffered for a long time with eczema and rosacea. I always felt a bit left out only using prescription products. This was a wonderful buy and has transformed my skin. Less overall redness and it feels soft and hydrated after use. Paired with the centella cream I am never looking back!
It's very runny and therefore easy to loose some when you go to apply it. But it does seem to cleanse the skin nicely and with enough on the skin it does lather up a bit when the water is added.
Only used for a short amount of time but feels safe and nice on my skin and doesn't irritate or sting at all
Smells great. My skin feels hydrated and clean after every use. 100% recommended.

I bought this cleansing oil to test it out. I find the texture to be oily which is good for drier skin. I use a different makeup remover however this oil does remove leftover makeup well and cleanses my skin. You have to use quite a lot to lather it on your skin, it feels as if I don't have enough on sometimes. Perhaps I'm applying the wrong technique. This oil pairs well with the centella cream also.
Really love this cleansing. And my skin too 😊 This smell-oh my gosh!!
A perfect cleansing oil for my night time routine. It won't remove my eye makeup, but that's a big ask. Happy to purchase this again when it runs out.
Really nice smell and skin feels great after use. Not used it loads as I only oil cleanse after wearing makeup which I don't do too often.
I use this with the gel and it's worked wonders on my skin, the reactivity, sensitivity, breakouts have mostly gone and left smoother, softer calmer skin. I'm soo pleased.
My skin always feels smooth and clean when I use this product. I've tried loads of different cleansing oils and this is the best one I've used.
A really lovely cleansing oil that doesn't leave my skin dry and removes all my make-up. It also has a lovely smell.
Beautiful light oil that dissolves make up effortlessly Smells amazing, like a super posh hotel Used with the gel and my night time routine has been transformed

After using the E45 cleansing foam for a while now due to very sensitive skin, I decided to switch to this cleansing oil as I am such a huge fan of other Erborian products. This oil removes make up very effectively and leaves skin feeling so moisturised - I only have to follow up with a little of the Centella Moisturiser afterwards. Can't believe how soft my face feels. I've definitely been converted! If you have sensitive skin, do what I did and order the small size first and see how you get on. I'm back on here today to buy the big bottle!

my face skin became so dry since I changed into some local product. Just within a night using Centella Cream and Kit Skin Therapy, those dryness disappeared! My facial skin feels so soft and looks glowy. Only just been using these products for a week, I can't recommend yet on the acne/blemish part. So far I have no new acne or blemishes though

I have tried many oil cleaners that are on the market as I wanted to incorporate double cleansing into my skin care routine but I always give up after couple of days of trying something as they leave my skin greasy and get into my eye effectively making my routine take double the time. However, I love this oil! Takes make up of really well, especially after using with the gel, smells great and feels the skin leaving smooth and moisturized rather than being greasy! I will definitely be buying again
Leaves my skin really clean, free of makeup and soft. No breakouts or reactions .
I never tried oil cleansing before and I'm glad I got this one. Is lightweight, doesn't grease up the whole face and removes makeup with no problem. Love the smell!
This product is beautiful... I've been using for a week or so now and I've really noticed a difference with my skin. 😍
Super gentle, used alongside the gel. Will buy full sized asap!
Removes makeup brilliantly and leaves my skin feeling clean and soft.
I love this product so far. This oil gives you very nourishing feeling and rinse off very easily. It keeps my face clean. Doesn't irritate my skin at all. I have oily, acne prone skin.
This is the best cleansing oil I've ever used. It's very light but very efficient, rinses clean and quickly, gets everything off. Very pleased with this purchase and will keep on hand
This is the best cleansing oil I've ever used. It's very light but very efficient, rinses clean and quickly, gets everything off. Very pleased with this purchase and will keep on hand

I use this once a day at night with my water based cleanser to remove the sunscreen and oils from my face. It does a really good job at removing excess oils, sunscreen, and other dirt and grime from outside. I highly recommend to give it a try and it also lasts a long time, you only need one pump. I bought it back in February and its not even half way finished (and thats with mostly consistent use).
Was very excited for this but sadly it irritated my skin and caused eczema. The smell is slightly weird and I wasn't sure if I liked that
Was very excited for this but sadly it irritated my skin and caused eczema. The smell is slightly weird and I wasn't sure if I liked that

Love using this oil. You could rub your face all day when rubbing this all over your face. Takes of makeup really well. The best oil cleanser I've used and probably the one I'll use. My fave product. Leaves your face feeling soft after use.

Love using this oil. You could rub your face all day when rubbing this all over your face. Takes of makeup really well. The best oil cleanser I've used and probably the one I'll use. My fave product. Leaves your face feeling soft after use.

I've purchased the 30ml size as used first time and I'm in love it it. I'm addicted to very natural yet fresh scent and love how it melts make up and it's easy to wash off. Definitely going for full size next time.

I've purchased the 30ml size as used first time and I'm in love it it. I'm addicted to very natural yet fresh scent and love how it melts make up and it's easy to wash off. Definitely going for full size next time.

I bought this on a whim and boy am I glad. This stuff is amazing. Cleanses the skin so well. No oiliness at all. Kinda crazy with it being an oil. I absolutely love this! Can't wait to try more from this brand.
I have a mixed skin - oily + dry in certain areas. This cleansing oil works great for my skin, it doesn't leave it oily at all! Does the job, smells great and leaves my skin soft.
This cleanser is amazing, it's gentle whilst removing all makeup, a fantastic part of a 2 step cleaning routine, it's my essential go to skin product by far

I've got eczema and always prone to dry skin breakouts, this oil cleanser is gentle and soothing. Doesn't strip my skin or leave it feeling dryer than before cleansing. Perfect to use before the gel water based cleanser. Great duo

Great cleansing oil that removes all traces of make-up effortlessly & is super gentle so does not sting my eyes. It is very light & rinses away easily leaving no oily residue, just soft & clean skin. I use together for a double cleansing routine with the gel wash & my skin really thanks me for it.
I used a travel size of this on my holiday recently and it was lovely! Smells great and did a good job of removing my make up! #erborianlovers
I have very sensitive eyes so have problems finding eye makeup remover. This oil is so gentle but totally removes all makeup.
